'''Fame Drimal'''<ref name="SWI147">{{InsiderCite|147|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Devious Neimoidians Revealed}}</ref> was a [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]]<ref name="RotS" /> [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]<ref name="SWI147" /> in the [[Neimoidian Gunnery Battalion]],<ref name="Blog" /> who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Originally stationed near [[Plagen]],<ref name="SWI147" /> a Separatist<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Drimal was reassigned to [[Security guard/Legends|guard]] the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] on the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]<ref name="SWI147" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC" /> Wearing Neimoidian guard [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and armed with a [[Neimoidian ceremonial blaster rifle/Legends|Neimoidian ceremonial blaster rifle]],<ref name="RotS" /> Drimal was posted to the right side of the door within the interior of the Separatists' leadership bunker, with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gap Nox/Legends|Gap Nox]] to the left,<ref name="FB">{{Facebook|username=star-wars-sourcebooks|url=notes/star-wars-sourcebooks/creating-naming-the-devious-neimoidians/676129629103814|name=Star Wars Sourcebooks|date=Jan 19, 2014|archivefile=File:NeimoidiansFacebook.pdf}}</ref> when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the apprentice of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and CIS ally [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], arrived. However, Sidious [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|betrayed]] the Council and Vader [[Death/Legends|killed]] Drimal and all other individuals present.<ref name="RotS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fame Drimal first appeared, albeit unidentified, in the [[2005]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="RotS" /> Drimal and Nox's scenes were shot on Stage 7 at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[September 8]], [[2003]]. The two Neimoidians, portrayed by [[Dean Gould]] and [[Christopher Mitchell]], were filmed being cut down at the doorway by Skywalker's actor [[Hayden Christensen]],<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> although this shot was cut from the final film.<ref name="RotS" />

Drimal was identified by name in the [[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]] department published in the [[Star Wars Insider 147|147th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="SWI147" /> which was released on [[January 21]], [[2014]].<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/147|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #147}}</ref> Drimal's character was expounded upon further in the creating and naming 'Devious Neimoidians Revealed' notes included in the Facebook page Star Wars Sourcebooks. However, Drimal was misspelled as "Dremal" in the notes.<ref name="FB" />
